Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1208 PM EST Sun Nov 15 2026
 

- Cloudy skies today will clear later tonight.

- Dry weather expected area-wide Monday through Thursday with a
  steady warming trend. 

&&

.AVIATION...

Predictability of MVFR ceiling is the aviation forecast challenge 
for this afternoon and tonight. The latest satellite trend indicates 
areas of vulnerability around the otherwise firmly established cloud
field off Lake Michigan. Corridors of low level dry air show more 
effectiveness off shorter lake fetch areas and up against a measured 
daytime heating . At the same time, the solid overcast covering NW 
into SE Lower Mi holds firm as cloud layer wind gradually backs 
toward the west tonight. A few breaks in coverage from northern and 
SW Lower Mi this afternoon can be accounted for in the short term 
while maintaining a prevailing MVFR ceiling until the surface high 
pressure ridge slides across the central Great Lakes later tonight. 
The shorter westerly wind fetch of increasingly dry air reduces 
clouds off Lake Michigan and results in stratocu coverage reduced to 
low predictability streamers or pockets by sunrise that tend to 
shrink back toward the Lake during Monday morning. 

For DTW... Persistent low level NNW flow maintains MVFR ceiling this 
afternoon and evening. Breaks in coverage develop toward sunrise 
through Monday morning. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

*  High for ceiling at or below 5,000 feet this afternoon and 
   evening. Moderate late tonight and low Monday morning.
